cases.steps: notes_find with nothing.
notes_find with query "the", limit 3.
notes_read the first note notes.search found.

cases.case: Create a note in a chosen folder
cases.steps: notes_change create, title "{TAG}", text "First line", folder "Notes".

cases.case: Create a note in the default folder
cases.steps: notes_change create, title "{TAG} default", text "Hello".

cases.case: Add text to the end of a note
cases.steps: Find the note "{TAG}" with notes_find (query "{TAG}"), then notes_change append, text "Appended line".

cases.case: Change one passage in a note
cases.steps: notes_change edit on "{TAG}", find "Appended line", text "Edited line".
notes_change replace on "{TAG}", text "- one\n- two"; then notes_read it and check it shows the two list items.
notes_change rename "{TAG}" to title "{TAG} renamed"; notes_read it and check the title.
notes_change create_folder, folder "{TAG} folder".

cases.case: Move a note to another folder
cases.steps: notes_change move "{TAG} renamed" to folder "{TAG} folder"; notes_find folder "{TAG} folder" shows it.

cases.case: Create a note in a folder that doesn't exist yet
cases.steps: notes_change create, title "{TAG} new", text "Hi", folder "{TAG} new folder"; check the answer says the folder was made.
notes_change delete the "{TAG} default" note.
notes_change delete_folder "{TAG} folder" and "{TAG} new folder" (their notes go to Recently Deleted).

cases.case: Create a note with a real checklist
cases.steps: notes_change create, title "{TAG} list", text "- [ ] eggs\n- [x] milk"; notes_read it and check eggs shows as - [ ] and milk as - [x].

cases.case: Add to a note that has a checklist
cases.steps: notes_change append on "{TAG} list", text "- [ ] bread\nPlain line"; notes_read it and check bread shows as - [ ], Plain line is not a checklist item, and milk is still - [x].

cases.case: Change a passage in a note with a checklist
cases.steps: notes_change edit on "{TAG} list", find "eggs", text "brown eggs"; notes_read it and check it shows - [ ] brown eggs.

cases.case: Tick and untick a checklist item
cases.steps: notes_change check on "{TAG} list", find "bread"; then notes_change uncheck, find "milk"; notes_read it and check bread is - [x] and milk is - [ ].
notes_change delete the "{TAG} list" note.

groups.name: Messages

cases.steps: messages_find with nothing, limit 5.
messages_find with text "ok", limit 3.
messages_read the first conversation from messages.conversations, limit 5.
messages_send to "{TO}", text "{TAG}: text (please ignore)".

files_change write ~/Downloads/latchkey-check.txt with text "{TAG}" (overwrite true), then messages_send to "{TO}" with that path as the attachment and text "{TAG}: file", then files_change trash the file.

missing: Delete or react to a message

cases.steps: mail_find with nothing.

cases.case: Find mail by sender, date, unread
cases.steps: mail_find unread true, limit 3.
mail_find text "invoice", limit 3.
mail_read the first message mail.find found (mark_read false).
mail_read that message with conversation true.
mail_find has_attachments true, limit 1; mail_read its attachment 1.
mail_send to ["{TO}"], subject "{TAG}", text "Automated Latchkey check, please ignore.".

THE MESSAGE means the newest message whose subject contains "Latchkey check" (mail_find subject "Latchkey check", limit 1, any mailbox). If mail.send worked, wait until THE MESSAGE is the one it sent (shell_run "sleep 20" between tries, up to 4 tries). mail_send reply_to THE MESSAGE, text "{TAG}: reply".
mail_send forward THE MESSAGE to ["{TO}"], text "{TAG}: forward".
mail_change draft to ["{TO}"], subject "{TAG} draft", text "Draft".
On THE MESSAGE (search again): mail_change mark_read, then mark_unread.
On THE MESSAGE: mail_change flag, then unflag.

cases.case: Mark as junk and not junk
cases.steps: On THE MESSAGE: mail_change junk, then search for THE MESSAGE again and not_junk.
On THE MESSAGE (search again): mail_change move to mailbox "Archive" (or another mailbox of its account if there is none).
mail_change delete every message from the last 7 days whose subject contains "Latchkey check" (search with limit 50), except THE MESSAGE, which later checks use.
files_find path "~/Downloads".
files_find query "invoice", limit 3.
files_change create_folder ~/Downloads/latchkey-check.
files_change write ~/Downloads/latchkey-check/a.txt, text "one".
files_change append to it, text "\ntwo".

cases.case: Change one passage in a file
cases.steps: files_change edit it, find "two", text "three".
files_read it and check it says one and three.
files_find path to that file.
files_change copy it to ~/Downloads/latchkey-check/b.txt.
files_change move b.txt to ~/Downloads/latchkey-check/c.txt.
files_find query "kMDItemContentType == com.adobe.pdf" or "pdf", limit 1; files_read the first .pdf found (check its text comes back, or for a PDF without text, a picture of its page).
files_find query "png", limit 1; files_read the first .png found (only check an image comes back).
files_change trash ~/Downloads/latchkey-check.

groups.name: Shell

cases.steps: shell_run "echo hello && sw_vers -productVersion".

cases.case: Run a long command and check on it
cases.steps: shell_run "sleep 40; echo done" with wait 5 (it becomes a job), then shell_check that job with wait 30, again until it says done.
shell_run "read x; echo got $x" with wait 2, then shell_run with that job and input "abc", then shell_check it shows got abc.
shell_run "sleep 300" with wait 2, then shell_run with that job and stop true.
shell_check with nothing.
shell_run "mkdir -p ~/latchkey-check-dir && echo x > ~/latchkey-check-dir/f && rm -r ~/latchkey-check-dir" with writes ["~/latchkey-check-dir"] and why "automated check".

cases.case: Reach a device on the home network
cases.steps: shell_run "r=$(route -n get default | awk '/gateway/{print $2}'); nc -z -G 3 $r 80 && echo reached $r || ping -c1 -t3 $r".
shell_run "curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://example.com".
shell_run "open -g -j -a Calculator && sleep 2 && pkill -x Calculator; echo ok" with uses ["open"].

missing: Scripting other apps (osascript) or starting background services (by design)

cases.steps: browser_read url "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apple_Inc.".
browser_read with nothing.

cases.case: Click a link on the same site
cases.steps: browser_act click a link to another Wikipedia article (its ref from browser.read).
browser_read back true; check it's the Apple Inc. article again.
browser_act script, code "document.title".

cases.case: Click a link to another site
cases.steps: browser_read url "https://example.com", then browser_act click its only link (it goes to iana.org), then browser_read with nothing to check Claude's page shows iana.org.

cases.case: Type into a field and submit
cases.steps: browser_read url "https://html.duckduckgo.com/html/"; browser_act type into the search field, text "latchkey", submit true; check results appear.
browser_read tabs true.
browser_read screenshot true.
browser_act close; then browser_read tabs true shows Claude has no page or a fresh one.
computer_look show screenshot.

cases.case: Read the front window's buttons and text
cases.steps: computer_look show ui.
computer_look show apps.
computer_act key, keys "f12" (no effect in most apps). Do not click, move, type, or open apps.

groups.name: Calendar

cases.case: List calendars and the week ahead
cases.steps: calendar_find with nothing.
calendar_find query "meeting", limit 3.
calendar_find free true, from {TOMORROW}, to {TOMORROW}.

cases.case: Create an event with an alert
cases.steps: calendar_change create, title "{TAG}", start "{TOMORROW}T03:00", end "{TOMORROW}T03:15", alarms [5].
calendar_find query "{TAG}" from {TOMORROW} to {TOMORROW}, then calendar_find with its id.
calendar_change update that id, start "{TOMORROW}T04:00" (check it still lasts 15 minutes).
calendar_change update that id, repeat daily, repeat_count 3.
calendar_change delete that id, span future; then check calendar_find query "{TAG}" over the next 5 days finds nothing (delete any left).

missing: Invite people or answer invitations (macOS doesn't allow apps to)

groups.name: Reminders

cases.steps: reminders_find with nothing, limit 5.
reminders_change create_list, title "{TAG}".

cases.case: Create a reminder with a due time
cases.steps: reminders_change create, title "{TAG} item", list "{TAG}", due "{TOMORROW}T09:00".
reminders_find list "{TAG}" for its id, then reminders_change update, priority high, notes "changed".

reminders_change create, title "{TAG} subtask", parent the id of "{TAG} item", tags ["latchkeycheck"], flagged true. Then reminders_find id of "{TAG} item": works only when it lists "{TAG} subtask" under Subtasks, and reminders_find id of the subtask says Flagged: yes and Tags: #latchkeycheck.

cases.case: Change a reminder that has subtasks, a flag, and tags
cases.steps: reminders_change update the subtask, notes "still tagged", due "{TOMORROW}"; then update "{TAG} item", title "{TAG} item renamed". Then reminders_find id of each: works only when the item still has its subtask and the subtask is still flagged, tagged #latchkeycheck, and a subtask of the item.

cases.case: Unflag a subtask and make it a reminder of its own
cases.steps: reminders_change update the subtask, flagged false, parent "". Then reminders_find id of it: works only when Flagged: no and it is no longer a subtask.
reminders_change complete it, then uncomplete it.
reminders_find completed true, limit 3.
reminders_change delete it.
reminders_find list "{TAG}" for its count, then reminders_change delete_list, list "{TAG}", reminder_count that count.

missing: Removing a tag (the Reminders app offers no way Latchkey can reach)

contacts_find query "a", limit 3.
contacts_find with the first id contacts.search found.
contacts_change create, given_name "Latchkey", family_name "{TAG}", phones [{"label":"mobile","value":"+15550100"}].
contacts_find query "{TAG}" for its id, then contacts_change update, organization "Check Co".
contacts_change create_group, name "{TAG}".

cases.case: Add a card to a group
cases.steps: contacts_change add_to_group, group "{TAG}", id the card.

cases.case: Remove a card from a group
cases.steps: contacts_change remove_from_group, same group and card.
contacts_change rename_group, group "{TAG}", name "{TAG} renamed".
contacts_change delete_group, group "{TAG} renamed".
contacts_change delete the card (search again by "{TAG}" if its id changed).
location_read.
maps_find query "coffee", limit 3.
maps_find to "San Francisco City Hall".
maps_find to "San Francisco City Hall", mode transit.
maps_find address "1 Infinite Loop, Cupertino".
maps_find address "37.3318,-122.0312".

cases.case: No test notes or folders left
cases.steps: notes_find with query "{TAG}", and notes_find with nothing (the folder list). Delete every note whose title starts with "{TAG}" (notes_change delete) and every folder whose name starts with "{TAG}" (notes_change delete_folder), then look again. works only when nothing with the tag is left; otherwise failed, with what stayed.

cases.case: No test cards or groups left
cases.steps: contacts_find with query "{TAG}", and with nothing (the groups). Delete each card and group with the tag, then look again. works only when none is left.
calendar_find query "{TAG}" from 7 days ago to 60 days ahead. Delete each one with span future, then look again. works only when none is left.

cases.case: No test reminders or lists left
cases.steps: reminders_find with nothing, and with query "{TAG}". Delete each reminder with the tag (subtasks included) and each list whose name starts with "{TAG}", then look again. works only when none is left.

cases.case: No test email outside the Trash
cases.steps: mail_find subject "{TAG}". Mark every one read (mail_change mark_read, also those already in a Trash or Deleted Items), and delete (to Trash) each not already in a Trash or Deleted Items mailbox, then look again. works only when every one is read and in a Trash.
files_find path "~/Downloads". Trash ~/Downloads/latchkey-check and ~/Downloads/latchkey-check.txt if either is there (files_change trash), then look again. works only when neither is left.
